{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
p="specs/001-transactions/checklists/requirements.md"
s=open(p).read()
old="- Items marked incomplete would require spec updates before\n  `$speckit-plan`; none are incomplete. One carried-forward open item:\n  Claim-A candidate extension (put recency refresh on overwrite) to be\n  resolved in clarify/plan."
new="- Items marked incomplete would require spec updates before\n  `$speckit-plan`; none are incomplete. Carried-forward open items:\n  (1) Claim-A candidate extension (put recency refresh on overwrite) to be
  resolved in clarify/plan; (2) Claim-A round-2 resize expiry clarification
  (R07/R08 referenced but not yet defined) — recorded as assumption, revisit
  if a TTL/expiry milestone lands.\n- Milestone 2 validation run 2026-10-17: spec.md updated to retain R01-R03
  and add R04 (invalidate_many any/all, empty-removes-zero, invalid
  mode/tags rejected pre-mutation, invalidate compatibility), R05
  (resize validation, survivor+order preservation, shrink evicts LRU,
  grow evicts nothing, failed resize preserves state, maxsize property),
  R06 (generator tags consumed once, detached returns incl. nested
  structures). New user stories 4-5, FR-014..FR-019, SC-006, 8 new edge
  cases. Superseded design-note prose (empty all matches every key;
  resize may flush) explicitly overridden per R04/R05. `grep -c
  'NEEDS CLARIFICATION' spec.md` -> 0. All 16 checklist items remain [x]."
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new,1)
open(p,"w").write(s)
print("checklist updated")
PYEOF
echo === FINAL VALIDATION ===
grep -n '^## ' specs/001-transactions/spec.md; wc -l specs/001-transactions/spec.md specs/001-transactions/checklists/requirements.md; cat .specify/feature.json"}
